/work/ride-recall.title: Smit Bhanderi
h1: Intelligent Occupant Monitoring System for Shared Mobility
p: Current driver monitoring systems fail the moment the engine stops. Existing DMS/OMS focus on safety during the drive. Ride Recall addresses the critical minutes after the user exits the vehicle the phase where cognitive load is highest and routine is lowest.

Ride Recall is a retrofit intelligent system designed to solve the critical problem of forgotten belongings in shared mobility. By bridging the "post-exit" gap, we ensure that the transition from vehicle to destination is seamless and stress-free.

/work/studentenwohnheim-app-und-webporta.title: Smit Bhanderi
h1: A Unified Platform interface design for Student Living
p: The Studentenwohnheim in Ingolstadt manages multiple departments such as electrical, development, and photography, while also organizing events and providing services like a canteen/store. However, these activities were handled through disconnected channels, leading to scattered communication and inefficient coordination.  Students found it difficult to discover events, register on time, make purchases, or raise requests, while departments lacked a streamlined way to manage their work. Administrators faced challenges in tracking activities, resulting in delays, miscommunication, and an inconsistent user experience.

Designed a unified digital platform consisting of a student mobile app and an internal web portal to centralize all hostel services and operations.  The app allows students to easily explore and register for events, make purchases from the canteen/store, interact with departments, and submit requests in one place. The web portal enables administrators and department members to manage events, handle requests, track activities, and coordinate tasks efficiently.  This integrated solution reduces complexity, improves communication, and delivers a seamless and consistent user experience across all aspects of student living.
